basics.name: Sahil Shaikh
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 1.5+ years of experience scaling backend systems, CRM software development, mobile application development, and real-time applications. Proficient in Node.js, React, React Native, PHP, and SQL/NoSQL databases.

work.name: Trunetic Infotech
highlights: Engineered a secure multi-role RBAC architecture and implemented Redis-backed token rotation for the CRM, reducing redundant API calls by 80% and preventing session hijacking.
Built a real-time group chat and tracking pipeline using data payload structuring and streamlined state management, slashing message fetch latency from 6 seconds to under 1 second.
Architected a greenfield modular transport backend comprising 25+ REST endpoints, integrating localized Redis caching across 55+ call sites.

work.name: Aalzatech Software Solutions
highlights: Designed and built a lead scoring system using a multi-factor ranking algorithm, including the production database schema and REST APIs, to prioritize high-conversion prospects.
Developed a multi-tenant inventory management backend integrated with automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.
Built and optimized 40+ website pages, reducing page load time from 10 seconds to 2 seconds and increasing organic traffic by 10%.

projects.name: StreamPulse
projects.summary: Fault-tolerant monitoring and notification engine built with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka.
highlights: Architected a Kafka-based asynchronous pipeline that decouples check producers from database consumers and handles 10,000+ checks per minute without write hotspots.
Optimized time-series data retrieval using TimescaleDB hypertables and continuous aggregates.
Built a real-time notification system using Redis Pub/Sub and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for instant dashboard updates.

projects.name: V8 engine (open source)
projects.summary: Open source contributions to the V8 JavaScript engine.
highlights: Expanded missing mjsunit test suites for edge cases, verified ECMAScript specifications against slow-path execution flows, and audited runtime built-ins.

projects.name: Appwrite and LocalSend (open source)
projects.summary: Open source contributions to Appwrite and LocalSend.
highlights: Contributed code-quality improvements and a session-based PIN sharing feature.
